archimate:Outcome.name: Verified and Trusted Health Records that Improve Quality of Care
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Verified and Trusted Health Records that Improve Quality of Care" goal is a clinical data integrity objective focused on ensuring all electronic patient records are accurate, secure, up-to-date, and verified by authoritative sources to drive safe medical decisions.
Its purpose is to establish complete trust in clinical data across different systems, reducing diagnostic errors, redundant testing, and medical mishaps caused by incorrect or incomplete patient information.
Example: A hospital network achieves this goal by implementing cryptographic validation on its allergy lists, giving treating physicians 100% confidence that a patient's documented penicillin allergy is clinically verified before prescribing an alternative antibiotic.
